_readme: WZ Reader private mode — an example. Copy this file to private.json in the same folder as app.html to turn it on.
The viewer then opens only the documents below (app.html?doc=<id>), view only: no other document, no editing, no saving.
url: relative paths are resolved against this file, so they stay on your server. Use name when the URL has no file name (it must carry the extension).
print: true allows printing (off by default — printing is also 'save as PDF').
Not access control: the browser downloads the document to show it. Who may see it at all is your server's decision (sign-in).
This _readme key is ignored and may be deleted.
